title: Gemini CLI ran out of memory and crashed

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue reports a JavaScript heap out-of-memory crash when requesting a list of ~1000 moved files, but it lacks specific reproduction steps, environment/repository setup details, or JS stack frames pointing to the location of memory accumulation in the codebase.
triage_metadata.comment: Hi! Thanks for commenting on this issue, we need more information to triage the bug. Could you please share the specific steps or repository context to reproduce this out-of-memory error? If possible, running the `/bug` command in Gemini CLI when memory usage is high will capture a V8 heap snapshot that can help pinpoint where memory is being allocated.
